personality_one_liner: A cinematic, ultra-premium companion app balancing deep atmospheric blacks with elegant champagne accents, clinical precision, and breathable spacing.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable margins (xl/2xl). Elements should never feel cramped. Avoid nested boxes without adequate padding.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar to let scrolling content faintly show through.
Use subtle glass over dark imagery for premium feature cards.
dont's: Do not use glass for standard dashboard statistic cards (use surfaceSecondary).
Do not overuse blur to the point of reducing readability.

screens.name: Header (Global Component)
screens.purpose: A consistent, elegant top navigation bar used across the app.
screens.layout: Replace the broken text-based header ('YOUR BEAUTY EXPERT' + lines + 'Nūr Skincoach') with a clean header. Center: The brand logo image (assets/images/nur-logo.png) rendered with resizeMode='contain' and a height of ~24-28pt. Left: Back button (if applicable). Right: Empty or settings icon. Add generous vertical padding (lg) and respect top safe area.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of user's LED therapy progress and next session.
screens.layout: 1. Greeting (Serif display, xl). 2. Stats Grid: Use flex: 1 for equal column widths. DO NOT use hardcoded widths. Card layout: subtle surfaceSecondary background, md radius, icon at top left, giant number (Serif, 2xl), and label (Sans, sm) below. 3. Daily LED Card: Highlight the color of the day with a soft glow effect. 4. Weekly progress chart or session dots.

states.empty: Zero state - 'Start your first session today' with a gold CTA.
states.error: Unable to load data, tap to retry.

screens.name: Skincoach Chat
screens.purpose: AI conversational interface for skin consultation.
screens.layout: Message bubbles should have subtle radii. User bubbles in surfaceTertiary, AI bubbles in surfaceSecondary with a subtle gold left-border. Keep the text highly readable (DM Sans, base, line-height 1.5). Voice input button anchored at bottom (safe-area aware).

states.empty: Welcome prompt from AI with quick-start question chips.

instructions_to_main_agent: TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (400, 500) for Display/Headlines and 'DM Sans' (400, 500) for Body/UI. Download/load these via raw TTF or standard methods without relying on @expo-google-fonts due to strict project constraints. NEVER use weights above 500.

ANTI-BREAKING RULES (CRITICAL): The client specifically complained about words like 'STREAK' and 'SESSIONS' breaking mid-word ('STREA / K'). To fix this forever: 1. NEVER use letterSpacing on UI labels. 2. Use flex: 1 on grid cards instead of hardcoded fixed widths. 3. For any single-line data label, apply `numberOfLines={1}`, `adjustsFontSizeToFit`, and `minimumFontScale={0.7}`. 4. If using FR/EN translations, test layouts with the longest possible word (e.g., 'SÉANCES').

HEADER REDESIGN: Remove the currently broken 'YOUR BEAUTY EXPERT' dual-line gold text and the misaligned 'Nūr Skincoach' text. Replace it entirely with the official PNG logo (`assets/images/nur-logo.png`). The logo must be centered, vertically aligned, and cleanly framed by safe areas.

COLOR THEME: The client explicitly demands a dark theme ('fond noir'). Do NOT change to light mode. Use surface: #050505, surfaceSecondary: #141414, and champagne gold accents (#C9A961). Ensure contrast is AA compliant by using cream/ivory (#FBF7F0) for primary text on dark backgrounds.

ALIGNMENT & UX: Fix all misaligned texts mentioned by the client. Ensure robust Flexbox usage (alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between') rather than manual margins. Give elements room to breathe (xl or 2xl spacing between major sections) to convey a premium 'Luxe' feel.
HAPTICS: Add subtle haptic feedback on tab changes and primary CTA presses to reinforce the premium hardware connection.
